Also checked manchester.ac.uk undergraduate fees-and-funding and international fees pages and studentsupport.manchester.ac.uk standard tuition fees page.

notes2028: No 2028-entry fees found: /study/undergraduate/courses/2028/ returns 404; the international fees page only says the University "reserves the right to increase the tuition fee by up to 7% each year" for subsequent years. The studentsupport standard tuition fees page (covers 2025/26 and 2026/27) mentions a government cap of £10,050 for 2027-28 "subject to Parliamentary approval"; this is a cap statement, not a course fee, and course pages state £10,050 without a caveat.
